name: medhub24-deploy
description: Deploy-only directory. Set Cloudflare's build Root directory to `deploy`. Pointed at the repository root instead, the Installing step fails in ~3s: pnpm-lock.yaml is lockfileVersion 5.3 (pnpm 6-era) which a current pnpm rejects outright, and pnpm-workspace.yaml globs playground/**, an empty git submodule. None of that tooling is used by the site. This directory has no dependencies and no lockfile, so Installing is a no-op. The build script is a deliberate no-op too, so a Build command of `pnpm run build` succeeds here rather than failing on a missing script — the site is plain files and needs no build either way.

scripts.build: echo 'Static site — nothing to build. See ../medhub24 and wrangler.jsonc.'
